name: banano-quest
description: A 2D platformer game where a monkey collects Banano coins

scripts.cap:init: npx cap init 'Banano Quest' com.bananoquest.app --web-dir dist
scripts.cap:build: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.store-assets: npm run generate-icons && npm run generate-feature
scripts.launch: npm run build && npm run deploy
